build_annotated_pseudo_orders_wrapper: build a pseudo orders wrapper from a model path and overrides dict for all or single order tasks
produce_pseudo_orders_for_phase_all: produce pseudo orders for a given power and phase using the DevOnlyAnnotatedPseudoAllOrdersWrapper class
produce_pseudo_orders_for_phase_single: produce pseudo orders for a power and recipient pair using the DevOnlyAnnotatedPseudoSingleOrdersWrapper class
score_candidate_pseudo_orders: score candidate joint actions as pseudo orders for a message using self and partner view scoring
format_output_seq_all: format a raw model prediction string into a JointAction or rollout dict using the all orders unflattener
